description: Task guidance for declaring official government identity and affiliation on a page
useWhen: the page must identify the government organization behind it
trust indicators (official domain, required links) are required
a footer must carry the mandated identity elements
avoidWhen: the property is not an official government site
a component-level identity mark already carries the affiliation

doctrine.note: the identifier communicates the agency and site identity and carries the required links (accessibility, privacy, FOIA)

knownFailureModes.note: the USWDS identifier banner has no equivalent in any other registry — rebuilds improvised four different treatments (DSFR substituted fr-notice, ECL merged into the header, GOV.UK/Canada omitted); the identity role must be decided deliberately per registry
